scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web & wait
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.app:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.app:build: npm run build -w web && npm run dist -w desktop
